<subject>URGENT - REQUIRES IMMEDIATE ACTION - Nordwind Grid Orientation tomorrow @The Elbe Tower</subject>
<body>
Date: Thursday, 23 January 2025

Location: The Elbe Tower Conference Center

Orientation will be split into two sessions and divided by alpha-order. Sessions will run 10am-1pm and 2pm-5pm.

We encourage all of you to attend your designated session as important operational updates will be covered, and you will have the chance to ask any questions about grid management policies.

Please bring your Nordwind Energie ID badge or official photo ID.

You can expedite the process by completing the attached registration forms - or fill them out on-site tomorrow.

10am Session   Letters A-K

2pm Session   Letters L-Z

Registration will be outside the Baltic Room.

Bus Transportation

Buses will depart from the Hafenstraße entrance lobby on the ground floor of the west wing at:

First session 				Second session  
8:45am-9am				12:45pm-1pm  
</body>
